steps.text: The page shows the community's current information: name, description, website, and registered office address. Click **Edit** to switch to edit mode.
steps.title: Community information page

steps.text: Switch the community card to edit mode.
steps.title: Edit

steps.text: Fill in the fields: **Description**, **Website** (full URL starting with https://) and the registered office address fields — street, number, postcode, and city. All four address fields must be filled together or left empty.
